parent_objective: audit no-rollout scenario taxonomy preflight before execution design
blocked_by: need preflight audit before measured scenario taxonomy execution design
supersedes: direct scenario taxonomy execution design after M1728

public_gates: M1729 must audit M1728 preflight pass/fail before execution design
M1729 must verify 6 families, 72 specs, 864 matrix cells, 12 profiles, zero contract violations, and zero missing artifacts
M1729 must verify unsupported fault-like features are explicit and not silently approximated
M1729 must decide execution design, taxonomy repair, or branch synthesis
M1729 must not run rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout or rank controller families
forbidden_shortcuts: do not silently approximate unsupported fault features

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits no-rollout scenario taxonomy materialization before execution design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: preflight audit only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if any family or profile coverage is missing
stop if unsupported fault-like features were silently approximated
fallback_plan: route to taxonomy repair if preflight failed
route to execution design if preflight is clean
route to branch synthesis if taxonomy materialization exposes a design flaw
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1728 completes no-rollout scenario taxonomy preflight

blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1729 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up execution design or taxonomy repair manifest

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; preflight audit cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit must preserve controller-family controls and must not convert them into ranking evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If taxonomy preflight fails, record it as scenario-design evidence rather than self-ID failure.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1728 can be audited as a clean no-rollout scenario taxonomy preflight before measured execution design.
success_criteria: M1728 result_class and guardrails are audited
contract and missing artifact counts are audited
next route is execution design taxonomy repair or synthesis
rollout execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes ranking and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit ignores contract violations or missing artifacts
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur

commands.name: audit
commands.command: write scenario taxonomy preflight result audit

decision_rule: M1729 passes if it audits M1728 and routes to execution design, taxonomy repair, or synthesis without overclaiming.
